assumptions: Raw counts were not provided; counts were reconstructed from the percentages assuming the smallest total N per sample that reproduces every percentage at 2 d.p. and sums to N (P1=48, P2=310, P3=125, P4=77, P5=402, P6=190).
Larger multiples of N also fit, which would change the results; the smallest was chosen as the most plausible.
issues: assemblages.tsv holds percentages, not raw counts as task.md requires. Bray-Curtis on percentages would differ from Bray-Curtis on counts, so counts were reconstructed.
summary: Reconstructed integer counts from percentages, then computed Bray-Curtis (1-2*sum(min)/(sum A+sum B)) for all 15 pairs on the unstandardised counts.
